claim_summary: AlphaCast contributes a feedback-driven forecasting workflow that uses retrieved temporal features and cases to generate, evaluate, and refine time-series forecasts.

claim_evidence.quote: we propose AlphaCast, an interaction-driven agentic reasoning framework that enables accurate time series forecasting with training-free large language models.
we develop a lightweight toolkit comprising a feature set, a knowledge base, a case library, and a contextual pool

modules.name: Temporal feature extraction
modules.scope_reason: The feature computation operates on temporal series and their sequential structure, without embedding a forecast output objective; if the task family changed, the temporal feature operations would remain usable, so R3_2_GTS applies rather than R3_1_TSK.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - feature extraction does not itself require a forecasting output
R3_2_GTS:yes - extracts properties from ordered time-series observations

evidence.quote: AlphaCast extracts temporal features from endogenous time series and exogenous variables to summarize temporal dynamics.

modules.name: Model-linked historical-case forecasting context
modules.scope_reason: The case library associates each training sample with its optimal candidate forecasting model and retrieves forecasts for use as a prediction baseline. Its cases and outputs encode the forecasting objective; changing task family requires changing the stored model outputs and selection logic, so R3_1_TSK applies despite the temporal history retrieval.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - stores and retrieves candidate forecasts for the forecasting output objective
R4:Memory and Context; Tools and Execution

evidence.quote: AlphaCast constructs a case library by associating each training sample ⟨Xi , Yi ⟩ with its optimal candidate model Mi selected from the candidate pool M

modules.name: Context-guided forecast generation
modules.scope_reason: The generator starts from a case-based forecast and produces an adjusted forecast for the requested horizon. The output requirement is forecasting; if the task family changed, the generation objective and forecast representation would need redesign, so R3_1_TSK applies.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - generates a forecast by adjusting a forecasting baseline
R5:not_applicable - no separate temporal function is required for this task procedure

evidence.quote: Given the consolidated context Icon , AlphaCast derives an intermediate prediction Yint through reasoning-driven generation instead of single-pass regression.

modules.name: Reflective forecast evaluation and refinement
modules.scope_reason: The reflector checks whether a forecast meets task requirements and evidence constraints, then returns feedback that changes the next forecast. Its criteria are defined around forecast validity; another task family would require redesigning its output checks, so R3_1_TSK applies.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - validates and refines forecasting outputs against task requirements

evidence.quote: AlphaCast includes a reflection stage to verify the prediction and support iterative refinement.
